generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Advance work including raising of seedlings under ANR Model, Clear felled area(Tiger corridor) in KFDF Scheme Kargadi sy no 13, Nagara Range, 10HA

itemList.description: Survey and demarcation of Plantation boundary lines after clearing the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas with thick under growth
Barbed wire fencing as provided in the SSR at Item No. 86)
Aligning in the planting area and marking for pit (without staking) (Aligning of pit in Stagerred design)

Excavation of pits of size 0.6 Mtr. x 0.6 Mtr.  x 0.6 Mtr. with vertically cut edges to make an uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top soil on the upper side & 2/3rd on the lower side) in Hard Soil. (400 pits x 0.60 cum  1 pit = 86.40 cum)
Cost of Raising 8" x 12" PB seedling, including 10% Casuality Replacement
